headlines.title: 서울 집주인, 재산세 5119억 더 냈다 [H-EXCLUSIVE]
headlines.summary: 2026년 서울시 주택 재산세 현황 총 3조8961억원…전년比 15.1% 증가 집값·공시가 상승 영향에 세 부담↑ 강남 등 공시가 12억 초과 42% 급등 12억 이하 주택은 8.7% 가량 줄어 올해 서울 주택분 재산세 관련 세액이 5000억원 이상 늘어난 가운데 증가분 상당수가 공시가격 12억 초과 주택에 집중된 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 재산세 증가분 57%가 강남3구 …‘공시가 12억 초과 ’ 한강벨트만 65만채
headlines.summary: 서울 재산세 증가 5119억, 강남3구 2920억↑ 강남3구 재산세 1.7조…서울 전체 44% 차지 동작 210% 상승 등 고가주택 강남 넘어 확산 집값 상승·공시가 인상, 한강변 세부담 확대 서울 중구 남산공원에서 바라본 강남·서초 일대의 아파트 단지의 모습.

headlines.title: " 부동산 세금 , 너무 어려워 "…국세청에 양도세 질의 2배 급증
headlines.summary: 올해 1∼7월 국세청에 접수된 부동산 관련 세금 질의 지난해 전체의 90% 넘어 양도·종부·상증세 질의 총 2726건 올해 부동산 세금에 대한 문의가 급격히 늘어난 것으로 나타났다. 정부의 다주택자 양도세 중과 재개와 장기보유특별공제 등 부동산 세제를 손질하면서 납세자의 불확실성을 키웠다는 지적이다. 특히 양도소득세 질의는 지난해의 2배 가까이로 늘었다.

headlines.title: 반도체 이익, 반도체 투자에만 집중 … 체감 안되는 호황
headlines.summary: 올해 설비투자 7.9% 증가 전망 경제 전반으로 성장 온기 안퍼져 반도체 호황이 기업 이익과 세수는 빠르게 끌어올리고 있지만 임금과 국내 투자로 번지는 속도는 이를 따라가지 못하고 있다. 반도체 중심 성장의 과실이 경제 전반으로 확산되지 못하면서 수출·성장 지표와 체감경기 간 괴리가 커지고 있다는 지적이 나온다.

headlines.title: 관세청, 반도체 공정용 가스 조절장비 ‘ 무관세 결정 ’
headlines.summary: 관세청이 품목 분류 기준을 정비해 그간 3% 관세가 부과됐던 반도체 제조공정용 가스압력 조절 장비를 무관세 품목으로 결정했다. 관세청은 지난달 13일 열린 ‘2026년 5회 관세품목분류위원회’에서 총 9건의 품목분류를 결정했으며, 이를 반영한 ‘수출입물품 등에 대한 품목분류 변경고시’ 개정안을 14일 관보에 게재했다고 밝혔다.

headlines.title: 韓 경기선행지수, 75개월 만에 17개국 중 1위 … 오름폭은 둔화
headlines.summary: 8월 102.87…5년3개월 만에 최고 지난해 2월부터 19개월 연속 상승 작년 9월 16위에서 올해 1위로 월 상승폭은 0.43→0.06포인트 [대구=뉴시스] 이무열 기자 = 제80주년 광복절인 15일 대구의 한 아파트에 태극기가 게양돼 있다. 2025.08.15. lmy@newsis.

headlines.title: 9~10월 도입 물량 원유 90% 확보했지만 …‘ 비축유 스와프 ’ 총동원

headlines.title: “ 비싼 한우는 구경만 ”… 수입 삼겹살 소비 49% 급증

top5_headlines.summary: 관세청이 품목 분류 기준을 정비해 그간 3% 관세가 부과됐던 반도체 제조공정용 가스압력 조절 장비를 무관세 품목으로 결정했다. 관세청은 지난달 13일 열린 ‘2026년 5회 관세품목분류위원회’에서 총 9건의 품목분류를 결정했으며, 이를 반영한 ‘수출입물품 등에 대한 품목분류 변경고시’ 개정안을 14일 관보에 게재했다고 밝혔다.

top5_headlines.title: 美금리인상, 유가·환율 상승 … 한은 ‘ 금리 인상 ’ 이어가나
top5_headlines.summary: 연준 금리인상 확률 85.8%로 급등 원화 약세에 고유가까지 ‘이중 충격’ 한은 내달 금통위 추가 인상 주목 미국의 고용과 물가 지표가 잇달아 시장 예상을 웃돌면서 15~16일(현지시간) 열리는 연방공개시장위원회(FOMC)에서 기준금리가 인상될 가능성이 커지고 있다.

top5_headlines.title: " 부동산 세금 , 너무 어려워 "…국세청에 양도세 질의 2배 급증
top5_headlines.summary: 올해 1∼7월 국세청에 접수된 부동산 관련 세금 질의 지난해 전체의 90% 넘어 양도·종부·상증세 질의 총 2726건 올해 부동산 세금에 대한 문의가 급격히 늘어난 것으로 나타났다. 정부의 다주택자 양도세 중과 재개와 장기보유특별공제 등 부동산 세제를 손질하면서 납세자의 불확실성을 키웠다는 지적이다. 특히 양도소득세 질의는 지난해의 2배 가까이로 늘었다.

top5_headlines.title: 반도체 이익, 반도체 투자에만 집중 … 체감 안되는 호황
top5_headlines.summary: 올해 설비투자 7.9% 증가 전망 경제 전반으로 성장 온기 안퍼져 반도체 호황이 기업 이익과 세수는 빠르게 끌어올리고 있지만 임금과 국내 투자로 번지는 속도는 이를 따라가지 못하고 있다. 반도체 중심 성장의 과실이 경제 전반으로 확산되지 못하면서 수출·성장 지표와 체감경기 간 괴리가 커지고 있다는 지적이 나온다.

top5_headlines.title: 韓 경기선행지수, 75개월 만에 17개국 중 1위 … 오름폭은 둔화
top5_headlines.summary: 8월 102.87…5년3개월 만에 최고 지난해 2월부터 19개월 연속 상승 작년 9월 16위에서 올해 1위로 월 상승폭은 0.43→0.06포인트 [대구=뉴시스] 이무열 기자 = 제80주년 광복절인 15일 대구의 한 아파트에 태극기가 게양돼 있다. 2025.08.15. lmy@newsis.

key_headlines.title: Customs Administration Grants Tariff-Free Status to Semiconductor Gas Control Equipment
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's Customs Service reclassified semiconductor manufacturing gas pressure control equipment as tariff-free, removing the previous 3% tariff. The change was announced through the Tariff Classification Committee and published in the official gazette on September 14.

key_headlines.title: US Fed Rate Hike Probability Surges to 85.8% Amid Strong Economic Data
key_headlines.summary: Strong US employment and inflation data have increased the likelihood of a rate hike at the upcoming FOMC meeting on September 15-16. The Bank of Korea is expected to consider further rate increases in response to US monetary tightening and weakening won.

key_headlines.title: Real Estate Tax Inquiries Surge 2-fold as Taxpayers Face Complex Tax Rules
key_headlines.summary: Inquiries about property-related taxes to the National Tax Service from January to July exceeded 90% of the entire previous year, with capital gains tax questions nearly doubling. Government's revised tax policies on multi-home owners and long-term holding deductions have increased taxpayer uncertainty.

key_headlines.title: Semiconductor Profits Concentrated in Sector; Economic Benefits Not Spreading Widely
key_headlines.summary: While semiconductor boom is rapidly boosting corporate profits and tax revenues, wage growth and domestic investment are lagging behind. Facility investment is projected to grow only 7.9% this year, highlighting the disparity between export indicators and consumer sentiment.

key_headlines.title: South Korea's Leading Economic Index Ranks First Among 17 Countries in 75 Months
key_headlines.summary: Korea's August leading economic index stood at 102.87, marking the highest level in 5 years and 3 months after 19 consecutive months of increases. However, the monthly rate of increase has slowed from 0.43 to 0.06 percentage points.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is experiencing mixed signals with semiconductor boom driving corporate profits and government tax revenues to record levels, yet broader economic benefits remain concentrated in the sector. The leading economic index reached its highest level in over 5 years, ranking first among 17 advanced economies, suggesting positive momentum ahead. However, real estate tax complexities are overwhelming taxpayers with inquiries doubling year-over-year, indicating regulatory uncertainty. Semiconductor equipment manufacturers are gaining tariff advantages as the government removes barriers to critical components. Overall, economic growth appears to be narrowing around semiconductor and related industries rather than spreading across the broader economy.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea is closely monitoring US Federal Reserve policy, with concerns that prolonged Middle East tensions could limit domestic growth to 2.6% next year while inflation reaches 2.7%. Corporate tax revenues are projected to exceed 216.7 trillion won next year, surpassing income tax for the first time in 15 years due to semiconductor windfall profits, yet this concentration raises structural economic concerns. The government is actively conducting tax audits on major companies including delivery platforms and retailers to address inflation-related tax evasion and ensure fair tax collection. Real estate tax policy revisions including capital gains tax increases on multi-home owners have created significant compliance challenges for taxpayers. US rate hikes and potential domestic interest rate increases are expected to further strain fiscal and monetary conditions in the coming months.
sections.Financial Markets: South Korean equity markets declined for a third consecutive day with Kospi falling to 6,684 points amid elevated US interest rate expectations at 87%, driven by strong labor and inflation data. International oil prices surging and AI momentum concerns have compounded negative pressure on technology stocks, particularly semiconductor names like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. US Treasury 10-year yields are approaching 5%, with German bunds reaching 3.54%, reflecting renewed inflation concerns across developed markets. The traditional formula of rate hikes causing market declines may be weakening as expectations of inflation control potentially supporting long-term valuations gain traction. Currency markets remain volatile with yen-dollar rates fluctuating based on monetary policy divergence between US and Japanese central banks.
sections.Industry & Technology: Gyeonggi Province is strengthening industrial partnerships with Michigan focusing on future mobility, semiconductors, and batteries by combining Michigan's automotive manufacturing capabilities with Korean semiconductor and battery technologies. Strike risks in steel, shipbuilding, and cable industries pose potential supply chain disruption threats, with labor negotiations becoming increasingly complex around wages, welfare, employment stability, and profit-sharing. US semiconductor testing equipment manufacturer Teradyne is experiencing 80% stock price gains this year as AI-driven demand for semiconductor testing capacity accelerates. AI is evolving into an industry expert capable of discovering optimal materials in hours versus previous months, as demonstrated in hair loss treatment research. Gyeonggi Province aims to leverage AI, semiconductors, and clean energy technologies for future industrial competitiveness.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul is offering below-market long-term lease opportunities in Cheongdam-dong with rents around 1.1 billion won for 20-year occupancy, applying income and asset-based qualification requirements. Gwangju apartment prices have risen for 9 consecutive weeks following the semiconductor national industrial complex designation, with sales activity and model house visits surging despite government restrictions on land transactions. Kangwon province is expected to supply approximately 700 apartment units this month including 400 units in Donghae and 290 units in Wonju. Seoul high-end apartment transactions remain active with the highest single transaction at 800 million won and four transactions exceeding 5.2 billion won. Strong real estate demand appears concentrated in regions designated for semiconductor development and premium Seoul locations.
sections.International Economy: The US Federal Reserve is widely expected to raise interest rates on September 16 given strong recent employment and inflation data, with recent economic indicators supporting a rate hike. President Trump has announced tariff elimination on Irish whiskey following a golf event meeting, demonstrating unpredictable trade policy making at the highest levels. Trump administration is threatening to halt trade with surplus nations if the Fed proceeds with rate increases, attempting to pressure Fed policy decisions ahead of FOMC meetings. Global markets remain jittery as energy supply chain concerns from Middle East tensions are rekindling inflation worries, affecting valuations across developed economies. US stock markets declined with Nasdaq dropping 1.2% as AI momentum concerns compound with rising oil prices and rate hike anxiety.
sections.AI & Economy: South Korea faces a strategic challenge transitioning from 30 years of rapid-follower (fast-follower) strategy that drove 5-fold GDP growth since 1996 to becoming a leading innovator in the AI era. AI is rapidly penetrating industrial sectors as demonstrated by hair loss treatment research discovering optimal materials from 420,000 candidates in days versus previous 22-month development cycles. Korea and Uzbekistan are expanding cooperation on AI, data centers, smart cities, and critical minerals, with export-import bank supporting strategic project development in these sectors. Young high-net-worth investors aged 30-40 are increasingly utilizing AI chatbots and tools for investment analysis, yet 76% still believe final decisions must remain human-controlled. AI's role is evolving from analytical assistant to specialized industry expert, though concerns about human oversight and decision autonomy persist.
sections.Others: Korea-Uzbekistan summit agreements focus on critical minerals, defense, high-speed rail, and AI cooperation, with strategic partnerships spanning from semiconductor technology to pharmaceutical and beauty sectors. A Chilean hydroelectric project worth 480 billion won was halted after a celebrity actor advocated for protecting endangered amphibians in the construction area. Young investors are increasingly utilizing AI for stock recommendations and portfolio analysis, though most remain skeptical about fully automated investment decisions. Gyeonggi University's food manufacturing school enterprise achieved the highest annual revenue among university enterprises nationwide at 14.1 billion won through OEM, ODM, and export operations. Korea's technological and industrial capabilities spanning semiconductors, automobiles, shipbuilding, defense, nuclear power, and batteries remain globally competitive despite persistent stock market valuation discounts versus major developed markets.
